'''Billy Jo''' (Japanese: '''ルー''' ''Ru'') is a minor character appearing in {{B2W2}} and {{aniseries|BW}}. She is a member of [[Roxie]]'s band, playing guitar.

==In animation==
===History===
===={{aniseries|BW}}====
Billy Jo appeared in ''[[BW083|Rocking the Virbank Gym! Part 1]]'' and ''[[BW084|Rocking the Virbank Gym! Part 2]]''. She is a guitarist playing with [[Roxie]] and {{un|Nicky}} in the band "{{p|Koffing}} and the Toxics", which is quite well known in [[Unova]] and provides music during Roxie's Gym Battles. When {{Ash}} came to the [[Virbank Gym]], Roxie described Billy Jo as a "poisonous person". 

She once went on tour with the band through [[Kanto]], but mentioned to Ash that the audiences there were "a bore".

==In the core series games==
Billy Jo appears at the Virbank Gym in {{B2W2}}. Here, she also plays in a band with Roxie, just like in {{aniseries|PTS}}. The {{player}} has to battle her before being able to battle Roxie.

===Pokémon Adventures===
===={{MangaArc|Black 2 & White 2}}====
Billy Jo appears briefly during a Virbank concert performance with her band-mates, Roxie and Nicky, in ''[[PS533|New Sword Player]]''. Neither Billy Jo nor Nicky are mentioned by name.

==Trivia==
*Fitting with how various Trainers of the {{tc|Guitarist}} class have names referencing real-life guitarists, Billy Jo's name is likely a reference to {{wp|Billie Joe Armstrong}}, the lead singer and guitarist of the band {{wp|Green Day}}.
